title: Robust Actor-Critic Learning under Transport and Divergence Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2611.22759v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning reliable control policies requires accounting for uncertainty in transition dynamics and errors introduced by function estimation and action generation. We develop an actor--critic method for discounted robust Markov decision processes with continuous states and actions and an unknown nominal transition law. We consider transition uncertainty sets defined by Wasserstein distance, total variation, Kullback--Leibler divergence, or Pearson chi-square divergence. A conditional diffusion model is fitted once to offline transitions. At each subsequent iteration, we estimate the robust action-value function from current-policy observations using a shared-target minimax criterion, then update a generative actor through exponentially weighted score matching. translated_title: 运输距离与散度不确定性下的鲁棒执行器-评论家学习
translated_abstract: 学习可靠的控制策略需要考虑转移动力学中的不确定性，以及函数估计和动作生成所引入的误差。我们针对具有连续状态与动作且标称转移规律未知的折扣鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程，开发了一种执行器-评论家方法。我们考虑由Wasserstein距离、全变差、Kullback-Leibler散度或Pearson卡方散度所定义的转移不确定性集合。该方法只需对离线转移数据一次性拟合一个条件扩散模型。在随后的每次迭代中，我们使用共享目标的极小极大准则，从当前策略的观测数据中估计鲁棒动作价值函数，然后通过指数加权得分匹配来更新生成式执行器。正则化在保持探索性的同时，为条件分布估计提供了所需的密度正则性。在覆盖性与正则性条件下，我们建立了有限……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种面向连续状态-动作、标称转移未知的折扣鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程的执行器-评论家方法，通过一次性拟合条件扩散模型，并结合共享目标极小极大准则与指数加权得分匹配，处理由Wasserstein距离、全变差及多种散度定义的转移不确定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an actor-critic method for discounted robust MDPs with continuous states and actions under unknown nominal transitions, which fits a conditional diffusion model once on offline data and iteratively estimates robust action-values via a shared-target minimax criterion while updating a generative actor through exponentially weighted score matching, handling transition uncertainty defined by Wasserstein distance, total variation, KL divergence, or Pearson chi-square divergence.
